claims.evidence: Witness report photo 0 shows a wooden cabinet/wardrobe with multiple open compartments/shelves and no fully closed door visible.

claims.claim: Can be used at home or boutique
claims.evidence: Witness report only describes the interior layout and wear; it does not confirm suitability for a boutique use case.

risks.risk: Missing/incomplete doors or hardware (doors/frames may be absent or not functional), which affects usability and value
risks.proof: A clear shot showing all door panels (if any), hinges, handles/knobs, and whether every opening is complete and can close/lock.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a wardrobe cabinet with incomplete/missing door parts and reduced functionality.

risks.risk: Stability issues (wobble) or damage to frame/sides not visible from the interior photo
risks.proof: A video clip showing the wardrobe being gently pushed/pulled to demonstrate wobble, plus close-ups of the sides, base, and corners for cracks/splits.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially unstable/with possible structural wear.

risks.risk: Shelf/hinge/handle condition and load-bearing strength (shelves may be weak or damaged)
risks.proof: A close-up of shelf surfaces and supports, and a clip showing a person placing weight on a shelf (carefully) to demonstrate sagging or looseness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/unknown strength with higher risk of shelf wear.

risks.risk: Overall dimensions and fit for the buyer’s space (may be too large/small)
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape (height/width/depth) or a tape-measure overlay in the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for fit (assume buyer may need a smaller/cheaper option).

risks.risk: Hygiene problems: stains, pests, water damage, or bad odor inside
risks.proof: A bright, wide interior photo plus close-ups of any stains, and a quick smell/cleanliness check shown in a short clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing cleaning and with unknown hygiene risk.

risks.risk: Clutter/dust level indicates poor condition and extra cleaning cost
risks.proof: A before-and-after cleaning clip or a clear close-up of dust buildup on shelves and compartments.
risks.if_unproven: Price as dusty/dirty and requiring cleaning.

proof_requests: Show the full wardrobe from front, side, and back (including any missing door panels) in one clear set of photos.
Provide measurements (height/width/depth) with a tape measure visible.
Show hinges/handles/locks (or confirm none) with close-ups and a short opening/closing test if doors exist.
Record a short stability test video (gentle push/pull) and close-ups of corners/base for cracks or splits.
Take close-ups of shelf surfaces/supports to check for sagging, cracks, or loose boards.
Show the interior hygiene: bright photos of all compartments for stains/pests/water damage and confirm it’s clean/odor-free.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies it as an open wooden wardrobe/cabinet, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. However, key risks (missing parts, stability, shelf strength, hygiene, and dimensions) are not fully verifiable from the provided interior photo, so pricing should assume the least favorable condition until proof is provided.
